fieldValues.title: P3: Instances
fieldValues.summary: States the tier frame before anything else; deletes the superseded three-tier note (X2 territory); re-parents the Instance mechanism leaf (ruling R4, Door 1); writes or deletes the empty 'Graduation: when and how' leaf; states the two-id-spaces rule once instead of per-occurrence; applies ordering.memberOrder to put Semantic maturity tier before Instance once srs-rust#1130/#1131 unblocked it. Concepts getting prose: Semantic maturity tier, Instance, Graduation.
fieldValues.body:
Part unit from the read-through (§4, unit P3; findings §2 Part 3). Depends on P2.

Landed via PR #840: bridged the Instances Part concept's own description to name the tier frame; deleted the dangling reference to the superseded three-tier design note; re-parented the stranded Instance mechanism leaf under its concept and trimmed it to the one new detail (ruling R4, Door 1); deleted the empty 'Graduation: when and how' leaf, re-parenting the Graduation-identity-continuity table under Graduation in its place; trimmed the Record tiers reference mechanism to a pointer.

**The headline scope item — reordering Semantic maturity tier before Instance — now landed too, via PR #843.** #840 confirmed the same memberOrder gap P2 hit, filed as srs-rust#1130; srs-rust#1131 fixed it (build.414). PR #843 declared ordering.memberOrder on part-instances in both compositions, putting Semantic maturity tier before Instance — resolving the two prior 'Note/Record before Semantic maturity tier' allowlist entries, replaced by new entries for the forward references the reorder trades in (Graduation depends on Note/Record, both nested under the tier concept that now renders first) — the same irreducible-cycle shape as srs#608, not a defect.

All scope delivered. Evidence: PR #840, PR #843.
